gauge.name: Cherry Creek (CO) at Denver

impacts.statement: Cherry Creek begins flowing over Steele Street.
There is extensive flooding of bike paths and foot bridges along Cherry Creek.
Water is over numerous sections of the bike path in downtown Denver.
Water near bike path and bottom of foot bridges crossing Cherry Creek.
